'''Laksana Tri Handoko''' (born 7 May 1968, in Malang) is an Indonesian scientist and public official specializing in [[theoretical physics|theoretical]] and [[particle physics]]. He formerly served as the deputy head of science and technology for the [[Indonesian Institute of Sciences]] (Indonesian: ''Lembaga Ilmu Pengetahuan Indonesia'', LIPI) from 2014 to 2018.<ref>[http://www.thejakartapost.com/life/2017/08/23/indonesian-research-productivity-lacking-lipi.html Indonesian research productivity lacking: LIPI]. [[Jakarta Post]], 23 August 2017. Accessed 2 July 2018.</ref><ref name=profile>[http://lipi.go.id/profil/ka Chairman Of LIPI] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191012035150/http://lipi.go.id/profil/ka |date=12 October 2019 }}. Accessed 2 July 2018.</ref> In 2018, he replaced Bambang Subiyanto as the acting chairman of the institute.<ref>Biro Kerja Sama, [http://www.waitro.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=494:officially-leading-lipi-laksana-tri-handoko-to-target-three-priority-programs&catid=1:announcementscat Officially Leading LIPI, Laksana Tri Handoko to Target Three Priority Programs]. World Association of Industrial and Technological Research Organizations, 1 June 2018. Accessed 2 July 2018.</ref>

He was Chairman of [[National Research and Innovation Agency (Indonesia)|the National Research and Innovation Agency]] (Indonesian: ''Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional'', BRIN) from 2021 to 2025.<ref name=":5" />

== Early life and education ==
Handoko born to Suyono and Susasi. His father was a [[physics]] lecturer at [[Gadjah Mada University]] and a part-time chicken farmer together with his mother.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Indonesia |first=C. N. N. |title=Laksana Tri Handoko, Petugas SPBU di Jepang Kini Kepala BRIN |url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/teknologi/20210604093758-199-650254/laksana-tri-handoko-petugas-spbu-di-jepang-kini-kepala-brin |access-date=2022-04-28 |website=teknologi |language=id-ID}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Dr Laksana Tri Handoko : Salah Jalur Kalau Ingin Kaya |url=http://lipi.go.id/berita/single/Dr-Laksana-Tri-Handoko-Salah-Jalur-Kalau-Ingin-Kaya/288 |access-date=2022-04-28 |website=lipi.go.id |language=en |archive-date=22 September 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200922200423/http://lipi.go.id/berita/single/Dr-Laksana-Tri-Handoko-Salah-Jalur-Kalau-Ingin-Kaya/288 |url-status=dead }}</ref> At that period, the physics lecturer did not earn adequate paychecks due to limited opportunities and salaries in Indonesia at that time, resulting in his father having a side job as a chicken farmer.<ref name=":2" /> Through chicken farming, his parents educated him on professionalism and hard work early in his youth.<ref name=":1" />

Despite his background, Handoko's love of physics and his love for physics bring him to [[Bandung Institute of Technology|the Bandung Institute of Technology]] for undergraduate study in physics.<ref name=":1" /> However, when [[B. J. Habibie|Habibie]] opened the Overseas Fellowship Program scholarship, he became an awardee and resigned from Bandung Institute of Technology.<ref name=":1" /> He completed his undergraduate study at [[Kumamoto University]],<ref name="profile" /> and then his graduate study in particle physics at [[Hiroshima University]].<ref>Martina Rosa Dwi Lestari, [http://www.netralnews.com/news/pendidikan/read/144732/menristekdikti-lantik-laksana-tri-handoko-menjadi-kepala-baru-lipi Menristekdikti Lantik Laksana Tri Handoko Menjadi Kepala Baru LIPI]. Netral News, 31 May 2018. Accessed 2 July 2018.</ref><ref>[http://www.fisika.lipi.go.id/webfisika/content/dr-laksana-tri-handoko-salah-jalur-kalau-ingin-kaya Dr Laksana Tri Handoko : Salah Jalur Kalau Ingin Kaya] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200224193539/http://www.fisika.lipi.go.id/webfisika/content/dr-laksana-tri-handoko-salah-jalur-kalau-ingin-kaya |date=24 February 2020 }}. Center for Physical Research, Indonesian Institute of Sciences, 5 December 2004. Accessed 2 July 2018.</ref><ref>''B Physics: Physics Beyond The Standard Model At The B Factory - Proceedings Of The 1994 International Workshop'', p. 461. Eds. A.I. Sanda and S. Suzuki. [[Singapore]]: [[World Scientific]], 1995. {{ISBN|9789814549394}}</ref>

Between his time of undergraduate graduation and master's study, he worked at a Japanese wood factory and later became a gas station employee in Japan.<ref name=":1" />

He became a fellow of the [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]] in 1999,<ref>Biro Kerja Sama, [http://lipi.go.id/siaranpress/laksana-tri-handoko-kepala-baru-lipi-yang-diharapkan-bawa-kemajuan-iptek-indonesia/20634 Laksana Tri Handoko, Kepala Baru LIPI yang Diharapkan Bawa Kemajuan Iptek Indonesia]. Indonesian Institute of Sciences, 31 May 2018. Accessed 2 July 2018.</ref><ref>Virna Puspa S, [https://www.antaranews.com/berita/715003/laksana-tri-handoko-dilantik-sebagai-kepala-lipi Laksana Tri Handoko dilantik sebagai Kepala LIPI]. [[Antara (news agency)|Antara]], 31 May 2018. Accessed 2 July 2018.</ref> and he's also the secretary of the Humboldt Alumni Association of Indonesia.<ref>[https://www.humboldt-foundation.de/web/alumni-associations.html Alumni Associations]. Humboldt Network. Accessed 2 July 2018.</ref>

== Careers ==

=== LIPI Scientist ===
After returning to Indonesia, Handoko joined LIPI. In LIPI, he joined the Theoretical Physics group. In 2002, he later became Head of the LIPI Theoretical Physics Group, a post he held for 10 years. In 2012, he became Head of the LIPI Research Center for Informatics. He rose to the rank of Deputy III (Engineering Sciences) of LIPI from 2014 until 2018.<ref name=":3" />

=== Educator ===
During this time as a LIPI scientist, he was appointed as a visiting professor at the Department of Physics [[Bogor Agricultural Institute]] (2002–2004) and the Department of Physics [[University of Indonesia]] (since 2002).<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |last=LIPI |date=2018-05-03 |title=Laksana Tri Handoko Dilantik Jadi Kepala LIPI yang Baru |url=http://lipi.go.id/berita/single/Laksana-Tri-Handoko-Dilantik-Jadi-Kepala-LIPI-yang-Baru/20714 |access-date=2022-04-28 |website=lipi.go.id |language=en}}</ref> At the time of his appointment as Chairman of BRIN, he still holds the visiting professor position at the University of Indonesia.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-04-28 |title=Profil Laksana Tri Handoko, Calon Kepala BRIN Pilihan Jokowi |url=https://nasional.tempo.co/read/1457145/profil-laksana-tri-handoko-calon-kepala-brin-pilihan-jokowi}}</ref>

=== Chairman of LIPI ===
He became the 10th Chairman of LIPI in 2018, succeeding Iskandar Zulkarnaen, the 9th Chairman of LIPI. Previously, the post was filled in an acting capacity by Bambang Subiyanto in the transition period between Zulkarnaen to Handoko.<ref name=":4" /> He was the penultimate chairman of LIPI.

=== Chairman of BRIN ===
On the second reshuffle of the [[Onward Indonesia Cabinet|Onward Indonesia cabinet]] that was announced on 28 April 2021, he was appointed as the second (but first independent) holder of Chairman of BRIN.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Rizqo|first=Kanavino Ahmad|date=2021-04-28|title=Ada Reshuffle, Ini Daftar Pejabat yang Dilantik Jokowi Hari Ini|url=https://news.detik.com/berita/d-5549333/ada-reshuffle-ini-daftar-pejabat-yang-dilantik-jokowi-hari-ini|access-date=2021-04-28|website=detiknews|language=id-ID}}</ref> After liquidation of [[Indonesian Institute of Sciences]] (Indonesian: ''Lembaga Ilmu Pengetahuan Indonesia'', LIPI), [[Agency for the Assessment and Application of Technology]] (Indonesian: ''Badan Pengkajian dan Penerapan Teknologi'', BPPT), [[National Nuclear Energy Agency of Indonesia]] (Indonesian: ''Badan Tenaga Nuklir Nasional'', BATAN), and [[National Institute of Aeronautics and Space]] (Indonesian: ''Lembaga Penerbangan dan Antariksa Nasional'', LAPAN) into BRIN on 1 September 2021, he currently become the Head of BRIN in its first consolidated form.<ref name=":5">{{Cite web|last=Jemadu|first=Liberty|date=2021-09-02|title=Semua LPNK Terintegrasi ke dalam BRIN sejak 1 September 2021|url=https://www.suara.com/tekno/2021/09/02/194723/semua-lpnk-terintegrasi-ke-dalam-brin-sejak-1-september-2021|access-date=2021-09-06|website=suara.com|language=id}}</ref>

=== Post-Chairmanship ===
After no longer become the Chairman of BRIN, Laksana was appointed as BRIN Research Professor with rank Principal Investigator Researcher thru Presidential Decision No. 36/M/2025 and stationed in Research Center for Quantum Physics, [[Research Organization for Nanotechnology and Material|Research Organization of Nanotechnology and Material]] (ORNAMAT).<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-11-12 |title=Lepas Jabatan Kepala BRIN, Handoko Dilantik Jadi Peneliti Ahli Utama |url=https://www.brin.go.id/news/125617/lepas-jabatan-kepala-brin-handoko-dilantik-jadi-peneliti-ahli-utama |access-date=2025-12-11 |website=BRIN - Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional |language=id}}</ref>

== Honors and awards ==

=== Scholarships and Fellowships ===

* Overseas Fellowship Program Scholarship, Batch IV, [[Ministry of Research and Technology]] (1987–1993)
* Science and Technology for Industrial Development Scholarship, Batch II, Ministry of Research and Technology (1993–1995)
* [[Monbukagakusho Scholarship|Monbusho Scholarship]], [[Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology]] (1995–1998)
* Postdoctoral Fellowship of the [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation|Alexander von Humboldt Stiftung]] (1998–2001)
* Postdoctoral Fellowship of the [[DESY|Deutsch Electronen Synchroton Stiftung]] (2000–2001)
* Postdoctoral Fellowship of the [[ASEAN]]-[[KOSEF]] project at [[Yonsei University]] (2003)
* Simons Regular Associate of [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] (2014–2019)
<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=L. T. Handoko |url=https://lt.handoko.id/ |access-date=2022-04-28 |website=lt.handoko.id}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=Profil Kepala BRIN |url=https://brin.go.id/profil-kepala-brin/}}</ref>

=== Awards ===
As a LIPI scientist, he was awarded by:<ref name=":0" />

* Adidharma Profession Award, Indonesian Engineer Association (2010)
* New Inventions That Are Beneficial to the Country Award, [[Indonesian Institute of Sciences]] (2010)
* The 400 most highly cited papers of All Time in the field of High Energy Physics - Phenomenology (2009)
* Outstanding Intellectual Property Award 2009 for Science in the sub-category of Computer, [[Ministry of Education and Culture (Indonesia)|Ministry of Education and Culture]] (2009)
* 101 Most Prospective Innovation 2009.
* Satyalancana Wira Karya (2009)
* Nominee Finalist of Research and Development Category, INAICTA 2009, [[Ministry of Communication and Information Technology (Indonesia)|Department of Communication and Information Technology]] (2009)
* Achmad Bakrie Award for Science (2008)
* Recognition Award of the e-Government and Services Category, APICTA Indonesia 2006, Indonesian Institute of Sciences (2006)
* Habibie Award of Basic Science (2004), Ministry of Research and Technology
* Winner of the Best Research and Development Category, APICTA Indonesia 2004, Indonesian Institute of Sciences (2004)
* Winner of the Best Education and Training Category, APICTA Indonesia 2004, Indonesian Institute of Sciences (2003)
* Young Indonesian Scientist Award, in the field of Natural and Environmental Science (2002)

As Chairman of BRIN, he was awarded [[Friendship Award (China)|The Chinese Government's Friendship Award]] by the Government of China. In his citation, he is credited with organizing collaborations in the field of nuclear and space research between Indonesia and China. The award was presented by the Chinese Ambassador to Indonesia, Lu Kang on 26 April 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |date=2022-04-27 |title=Kepala BRIN Terima Penghargaan Tertinggi dari Pemerintah China : Okezone Edukasi |url=https://edukasi.okezone.com/read/2022/04/27/65/2585835/kepala-brin-terima-penghargaan-tertinggi-dari-pemerintah-china |access-date=2022-04-28 |website=Okezone |language=id-ID}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-04-27 |title=RISET NUKLIR DAN ANTARIKSA, BRIN RANGKUL TIONGKOK |url=https://sinerginews.co.id/2022/04/27/riset-nuklir-dan-antariksa-brin-rangkul-tiongkok/ |access-date=2022-04-28 |website=SinergiNews |language=id-ID}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Hadi |first=Indria Purnama |title=Kepala BRIN Terima Penghargaan dari Pemerintah Republik Rakyat Tiongkok. Tingkatkan Kerjasama Indonesia-RRT - Titik Temu |url=https://www.titiktemu.co/nasional/pr-863285968/kepala-brin-terima-penghargaan-dari-pemerintah-republik-rakyat-tiongkok-tingkatkan-kerjasama-indonesia-rrt |access-date=2022-04-28 |website=Titik Temu |language=id}}</ref>

== Controversies ==
As Chairman of LIPI, he was seen as "revolutionary" by implementing revolutionary policies for LIPI reorganization. The most important revolutionary policy during his time were the reorganization of LIPI, which at time the size is very big due to having many non-optimal subunits into slimmer organization and archiving revolution. Due to his revolutionary policies, he was protested by his seniors at LIPI.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-04-28 |title=Calon Kepala BRIN Laksana Tri Handoko: Pernah Diminta Mundur oleh 65 Peneliti |url=https://nasional.tempo.co/read/1457125/calon-kepala-brin-laksana-tri-handoko-pernah-diminta-mundur-oleh-65-peneliti}}</ref>

His leadership style as leader of BRIN seen as "one man show leadership" and lack of compromising criticized and protested by his seniors and former colleagues.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-01-05 |title=Eks Pimpinan Lembaga Riset Menilai Gaya Kepemimpinan Kepala BRIN One Man Show |url=https://nasional.tempo.co/read/1546958/eks-pimpinan-lembaga-riset-menilai-gaya-kepemimpinan-kepala-brin-one-man-show/full&view=ok}}</ref> He was also become the center of polemic due to human resource issue resulted on [[Eijkman Institute for Molecular Biology|Eijkman Institute of Molecular Biology]] liquidation in early 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hutabarat |first=Delvita |date=2022-01-12 |title=DPR Minta Kepala BRIN Tak Berpolemik soal LBM Eijkman: Seperti Doddy Sudrajat |url=https://www.liputan6.com/news/read/4857883/dpr-minta-kepala-brin-tak-berpolemik-soal-lbm-eijkman-seperti-doddy-sudrajat |access-date=2022-04-28 |website=liputan6.com |language=id}}</ref>
